candidate: source metadata only; not a publication or operational acceptance attestation

compatibility.readers: Ignore unknown output fields; reject unsupported schema versions. Input contracts reject unknown fields.
compatibility.changes: Additive output fields within v1; removed fields, changed units/meaning or required inputs need a new contract version.
compatibility.state: Additive tables/columns on writable open only. Read-only inspect/status/report never migrate. Do not use an older binary on newer operational state.
compatibility.snapshot_reader_caveat: Container compatibility floor only; historical state may contain later additive features. Use the matching tool version for operational recovery.
compatibility.native: App Server stdio JSONL, initialize/initialized, experimentalApi:false; unsupported requests remain blocked; no automatic replay. Reference schema: 0.166.0; capability handshake is not a support guarantee.

errors.argument_parsing: Clap diagnostics on stderr; help/version/parse failures are outside the command JSON envelope.
errors.retry: Error codes never authorize retry; inspect unknown outcomes and submit a fresh explicit operation.

platforms.macos: native account exploratory pilots on earlier checkpoints; final candidate acceptance pending
platforms.linux: deterministic ARM64 VM/container baseline on earlier checkpoint; native account sandbox preflights blocked; final candidate pending
platforms.claude: deferred; no v1 native acceptance claim

publication: GitHub release, crates.io upload, visibility, push and merge require separate explicit authorization; none is triggered by a version number.
